correctness.rationale: Unique stationary law follows strictly positive refreshing transition matrix. Independent exact rational substitution tested the reduced three-pair correlation system and inversion for every (s,m) in {2,3,4}x{1,2,3,5}, copying c=2/3. Identity v-w=q(s-2)(s^2-q[s^2-2s+2+2(s-1)u])/(D_vD_w) and reconstructed m denominator equality were independently verified symbolically. Because 0<u<1, two lags recover s=(1-u)/(r2/q-u); H(u)=1-w+(s-1)(v-w)>0 makes u strictly decreasing in m and denominator positive. Centered star has r1=0,r2=q by alternating ancestry; all-star process does not depend on leaf count by independent symmetric leaf refresh. Finite checks supplement all-parameter contraction/ergodic proof.
residual_risks: Bounded independent calculations cannot replace the analytic universal argument; see proof boundary.

final_claim: For known 0<epsilon<1, synchronous fair-refresh noisy voting observed at the universal hub of K1 join mK_s is identified by its two stationary lag correlations whenever s>=2; all centered stars s=1 share the same entire hub process.
limitations: Only known fixed noise, fair synchronous updates, equal-size cliques and observed hub; estimates are limiting almost-sure frequencies, not finite-sample identification.
